title: Sequence Allocation Contract
summary: Allocate concurrent-safe, gap-free and auditable numbers through reserve and commit without owning document lifecycle.

criteria: Allocation is a two-step reserve and commit: a reserve holds a number against a scope key, and only a commit makes it final and visible.
Allocation is gap-free within a scope key: a reserve that is never committed is either committed later or explicitly recorded as a cancelled number, so the series stays auditable.
Allocation is concurrent-safe: two simultaneous reserves against the same scope key never receive the same number, and neither is silently dropped.
The scope key is explicit and tenant-bound, so a series is defined by tenant plus scope key and never shared across tenants.
document lifecycle ownership stays outside: this contract issues numbers and never decides whether a document is valid, posted, cancelled or reversed.
The multi-region posture is declared: under a CAP partition the contract prefers consistency and refuses allocation rather than issuing a possibly duplicate number.

risks.desc: Issuing the same number twice in a legally numbered series would produce two documents claiming one identity, which is a statutory and financial correctness failure.
risks.mitigation: Make allocation concurrent-safe by construction, prefer consistency under a CAP partition and prove distinctness with an adversarial concurrency burst.

risks.desc: An abandoned reserve that leaves an unexplained gap would make a legally numbered series unauditable and could read as a deleted document.
risks.mitigation: Require every reserved number to end committed or recorded as a cancelled number, and prove series reconstruction as evidence.

risks.desc: A scope key that is not tenant-bound would let one tenant consume or observe another tenant's numbering series.
risks.mitigation: Bind every scope key to one tenant, refuse cross-tenant allocation rather than rescoping it and keep the refusal a fixed negative-test axis.

risks.desc: A sequence allocator could be misread as owning document lifecycle, legal e-document formatting or general-purpose identifier generation.
risks.mitigation: Keep those three exclusions explicit in every phase, issue numbers only, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: Allocation is a reserve and commit pair against an explicit tenant-bound scope key, and only a commit makes a number final.
Girdi is a scope key plus a tenant context; çıktı is a reserved number and then a committed number, or an explicit refusal.
The series is gap-free and auditable: every reserved number ends committed or recorded as a cancelled number.
Allocation is concurrent-safe, so two simultaneous reserves on one scope key receive distinct numbers and neither is dropped.
Kapsam sınırı gereği document lifecycle ownership, legal e-document formatting and general-purpose identifier generation all stay outside.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Number distinctness is the primary control: a duplicate in a legally numbered series is an integrity failure, so allocation is concurrent-safe by construction rather than by retry.
The scope key is tenant-bound, so a cross-tenant allocation or series read is refused rather than rescoped, which preserves izolasyon.
Gap-free auditability is a security property: an unexplained gap can read as a suppressed document, so every abandoned reserve becomes an explicit cancelled number.
Reserve, commit and cancellation are recorded append-only with actor attribution, which keeps a numbered series an auditable denetim artifact.
Under a CAP partition the multi-region posture prefers consistency and refuses allocation, so availability pressure can never produce a duplicate number.

Kapsa: concurrent-safe distinctness, tenant-bound scope keys, gap-free auditability, append-only allocation records, consistency-preferring partition behaviour. codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one typed allocation katman for every series rather than a per-document-type allocator, so gap-free semantics cannot diverge.
Scope key derivation and series reconstruction stay pure functions with low cyclomatic complexity, testable without a datastore.
Allocation and document lifecycle stay separated; ölü kod and speculative per-country numbering variants are refused, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: The scope key vocabulary is closed and versioned, so introducing a new series is a reviewed change rather than something a caller can create implicitly by allocating.
Least ayrıcalık applies per scope key: a caller may allocate only in series it is entitled to, so a number cannot be consumed from an unrelated series.
Reserve lifetimes are bounded, so an abandoned reserve resolves to a cancelled number automatically rather than holding a position indefinitely.
The allocation yüzey stays kapalı: a caller supplies only a scope key and never a candidate number, and the allocator has no egress path that could seed a series from outside the platform.
securityOptimization.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: closed versioned scope key vocabulary, per-series least privilege, bounded reserve lifetimes resolving to cancelled numbers. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for a reserve and a separate budget for a commit on a hot scope key; no measurement is claimed here.
A single scope key is an inherent serialisation point, so the budget states expected throughput per scope key rather than assuming unlimited parallelism.
Allocation must avoid N+1 access; a batch reserve for one scope key is served in one round trip rather than once per requested number.
performance.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budgets for reserve and commit, per-scope-key throughput expectations, batched allocation without N+1. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client consumes a server-issued number; a cihaz may not generate a local sequence number offline and submit it as authoritative.
An offline client shows a document as unnumbered and pending rather than displaying a provisional number that a later commit could contradict.
No mobile numbering administration surface is introduced here; rendering an issued number stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: server-issued numbers only, unnumbered pending state offline, no mobile numbering administration. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future numbering administration surface must present the scope key, current position and cancelled number set as keyboard navigable content with a visible odak ring at the AAA kontrast threshold.
An allocation refusal, such as a partition refusal or a cross-tenant attempt, must be announced through an aria live region naming the reason.
This contract defines allocation semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: keyboard-navigable series presentation, announced allocation refusals, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future multi-region Kubernetes topology for an allocator remains human-developer work.
Opening a new scope key is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a container rebuild; rollback returns to the previous scope key set.
Reverting the allocator shard is confined to this planning contract and the files regenerated from it, so no series position or issued number shifts, runtimeDataImpact stays none and NO-GO remains.
deployment.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, scope key opening as an approved data change, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: A commit olay may notify downstream consumers that a number became final, but this contract never performs a business action such as posting the document.
A commit that triggers a downstream numbering action forms a chain that stops at maxChainDepth 6, so an allocation cannot cascade without bound.
Re-delivering the same reserve or commit event for the same scope key and reservation id must be idempotent, and opening a new series always requires an explicit onay.
eca.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: commit events without acting, depth-bounded numbering chains, idempotent reserve and commit replay, approval-gated series opening. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.
AI cannot reserve or commit a number, cannot open a scope key and cannot cancel an issued number; each of those needs insan onayı, and a cancellation additionally requires a step-up review.

Any allocation request reaching the lane as sub_prompt is untrusted, the kill switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, AI barred from reserving, committing, opening scope keys or cancelling numbers, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases reserve and commit against a scope key and assert the series advances by exactly one, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned concurrency cases prove simultaneous reserves receive distinct numbers and that none is lost under load.
Planned negatives prove an abandoned reserve becomes an explicit cancelled number rather than an unexplained gap.
Planned negatives prove a cross-tenant allocation is refused and that a CAP partition produces a refusal rather than a possibly duplicate number.
Gap-free and concurrency claims count only after a human-approved run has really executed them, and the planned matrix on its own proves nothing.
testing.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: reserve and commit positives, concurrency distinctness, cancelled-number negatives, cross-tenant and partition refusal negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A08 software and data integrity failures is the defining axis: a duplicate or unexplained gap in a legally numbered series is an integrity breach, so both are refused by construction.
OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by binding every scope key to one tenant and refusing cross-tenant allocation.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by declaring the reserve and commit split, bounded reserve lifetimes and consistency-preferring partition behaviour up front.

Girdi doğrulama applies to every reserve and commit: the scope key, tenant and reservation id are validated before a position is consumed, and every reserve, commit and cancellation leaves a denetim izi.
owasp.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A08 via duplicate and gap refusal, A01 via tenant-bound scope keys, A04 via declared reserve/commit split and partition posture. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-computation with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-sequence] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so an allocation touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; a commit notification arrives as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor event-bus-delivery-contract ends 2026-09-10, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly k-tenancy and event-bus-delivery-contract, and the parent's related list is not inherited.
Scope stays inside the allocation layer: document lifecycle ownership, legal e-document formatting and general-purpose identifier generation all stay outside.
integration.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-archetype-computation to k-sequence, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir a number through reserve and commit and may not maintain its own counter or reach a doğrudan tablo for the series position.
A consumer must carry the scope key alongside any stored number, so a later audit can tell which series produced it.
Deciding whether a document is posted or reversed belongs to the document lifecycle authority; this contract issues numbers only.
moduleUsage.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: allocator-mediated numbering without local counters or direct table reads, scope key carried with stored numbers, excluded document lifecycle authority. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: An issued number links to a commercial document and can therefore expose PII indirectly, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
Statutory numbering obligations usually exceed operational needs, so the allocation record saklama süresi is set by the longest applicable legal retention rather than the shortest.
Reserve, commit and cancellation records are retained append-only so a historical series stays reconstructable, and stored series evolve by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: indirect PII through document links, statutory retention driving allocation records, append-only series history and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include reserve and commit latency percentiles, abandoned reserve rates, cancelled number counts and partition refusal counts on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the scope key and reservation id; issued numbers and document references are redacted and never become metric labels.
Alerts cover any detected duplicate, any unexplained gap in a reconstructed series and a spike in partition refusals; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: reserve and commit SLIs, redacted scope-key traces, duplicate and gap alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is a partition or store failure mid-allocation; the contract refuses the allocation and leaves the prior series position intact rather than issuing optimistically.
Commit is idempotent by construction: re-committing the same reservation id returns the same number, so a retry with bounded backoff cannot consume two positions.
A repeatedly failing commit is routed to a dead-letter path for human review rather than retried forever, and a circuit breaker protects the shared allocator.
reliability.notes: sequence-allocation-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Sequence Allocation Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: refusal over optimistic issuance under partition, idempotent commit with bounded retry, dead-letter routing and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
